versions.changelog:
- skill-card.md file has been removed.
- SKILL.md updated with an explicit warning that archive.directory() does not support ignore/filter patterns.
- Added a new section explaining how to exclude node_modules from archives, including usage examples with glob() and alternative file-walking methods.
- No changes to functionality—documentation improvements only.

- Initial release of the archiver skill.
- Supports streaming creation of ZIP and TAR archives in Node.js.
- Allows archiving from various sources: file streams, strings, buffers, file paths, directories, and glob patterns.
- Includes event handling, progress tracking, and custom format registration.
- Provides example patterns for HTTP streaming, conditional packaging, in-memory archiving, and batch archive creation.
